verdict.rationale: Grafana's own docs say AI agents can connect through a first-party hosted Cloud MCP Server or a self-managed open source MCP Server. A probe confirms the official MCP server repository at github.com/grafana/mcp-grafana, so the core story is delivered directly. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting through the MCP server, and documentation detail on the exposed tools and authentication.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect AI agents to Grafana through the fully hosted Cloud MCP Server or the self-managed open source MCP Server.
official MCP server documented at https://github.com/grafana/mcp-grafana
